title: Answer
description:
Angels are servants. The Son is addressed as God, on a throne that stands. He is not a higher kind of creature.

A king can be called God and still have God as his God. Read of the Son, that neither splits Him from God nor collapses Father and Son.

Once that anointing is said of the Son, His companions cannot remain ordinary peers of a human king.

Words spoken to the Creator, who outlasts the heavens, are applied to the Son. Creation perishes and will be changed. He remains, and He is the same.
